delay_between_terminals.description: Random delay in seconds between opening terminals (min-max range)
Random delay in seconds between opening terminals for new accounts
Random delay in seconds for bulk operations

global.description: Delay for Global client operations (to avoid rate limiting)

japan.description: Delay for Japan client operations (to avoid rate limiting)

tutorial.description: For VIP users only: number of Greatest Warrior boards (1-5) to auto-complete after tutorial. 0 = disable.

chrome_setup.description: IMPORTANT: Google login requires Chrome browser. If you get version mismatch error, update Chrome to latest version from https://www.google.com/chrome/
chrome_setup.note: Only set chrome_binary_path if Chrome is in non-standard location (e.g., portable version). Leave empty to auto-detect. Example: 'C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe'

proxy.description: Global toggle for game API proxy (setproxy & applying proxy from saves). true = enable proxy; false = ignore proxy.

stamina.description: prefer_meat: use meat items first, then stones. use_stone: allow Dragon Stones for stamina refill. If both are false, bot stops when out of stamina.

game.description: team_build: auto build team based on stage limitations. Toggle ON/OFF from settings or 'tb' command.

auto_sell.description: Automatically sell eligible N/R/SR cards while farming or when the card box is full. The explicit 'sell auto' command remains available when this is disabled.

rank_up.description: Default stage ID and difficulty for rank command (0=Easy, 1=Normal, 2=Hard, 3=Z-Hard). Used when not specified.

blue_gems.description: Blue gems (Incredible Gems). Command asks for target quantity and farms until reached. Optional: treasure_item_id (number) to override auto-detect.

green_gems.description: Green gems (Support Memory Gems). Command asks for target quantity and farms until reached. Optional: treasure_item_id (number) to override auto-detect.

help.description: Help menu language: en, fr, pt, es, it, hi (Hindi). Command names stay in English; only descriptions are translated.
